display.note: Vertical roster body width. Full logical canvas is about 82 px wide at that size.

production.method: image_edit from the canonical PNG on every generated pose, then registered back onto the 1024 canvas
production.idleNote: Raw edits did not keep a connected wing. Upward poses detached the wingtips or lifted the tail. The downward pose stayed one piece but thickened the outer wing and dropped the tips by about 150 px. Shipped idle frames keep the canonical drawing. The outer wings are a smooth vertical bend of that drawing, amplitude taken from the downward edit and reduced so the tips travel 72 px. The rest frame is the canonical image so the hull, coil, and panel lines do not crawl.
production.firingNote: Coil and arc pixels are the image_edit frames, flood-filled off the black background and composited onto the canonical hull. The hull, wings, and tail are canonical pixels. The generator returned JPEG, so the coil edges carry compression.
rejectedEdits: Forward wing fold that replaced the swept wing with a narrower inner wing.
Tailplanes lifted and wings torn on two upward attempts.
Upward attempt that detached both brass wingtips.
Downward attempt kept one wing but thickened the tips. Used only as the drift measurement.
Rest redraw matched the hull within about 2 levels of mean absolute error and was not used, so the rest frame stays pixel-identical to the canonical PNG.
One coil edit turned the ring into a vertical stack and was discarded.
One recovery edit dropped the coil to a dull brown and was discarded.
